scene_family.name: procedural_tabletop_proxy_v0.1
scene_family.purpose: Test plan ordering and alternative goal bindings under repeatable physical manipulation without claiming category-faithful BEHAVIOR assets.
scene_family.geometry_source: Procedural Isaac Sim cuboids and fixed supports only.
scene_family.camera_policy: One fixed camera transform and resolution for every condition within a task.
scene_family.initialization: Deterministic layout by task source hash with seed-specific XY jitter bounded to plus or minus 0.005 m.

transfer.physical_proxy: A unique dynamic cuboid represents the transferred object; labeled support or containment slots represent source and target relations.
transfer.success_predicate: Object center lies inside the frozen target slot tolerance after a two-second release-stability window.

open.controller_primitive: Franka PickPlaceController removes a receptacle lid token to its open parking slot.
open.physical_proxy: A dynamic lid cuboid physically blocks the receptacle access slot while closed.
open.success_predicate: Lid token lies in the open parking slot and the access region is unobstructed.

close.controller_primitive: Franka PickPlaceController returns the lid token to the closed slot.
close.physical_proxy: The same dynamic lid cuboid used by open.
close.success_predicate: Lid token lies in the closed slot within the frozen pose tolerance.

toggle_on.controller_primitive: Franka PickPlaceController moves a switch token from the off slot to the on slot.
toggle_on.physical_proxy: A dynamic switch cuboid with visibly distinct off and on fixtures.
toggle_on.success_predicate: Switch token lies in the on slot within the frozen pose tolerance.

toggle_off.controller_primitive: Franka PickPlaceController moves a switch token from the on slot to the off slot.
toggle_off.physical_proxy: The same dynamic switch cuboid used by toggle_on.
toggle_off.success_predicate: Switch token lies in the off slot within the frozen pose tolerance.

rollout_success.reference_and_nonreference: Every listed action succeeds and every frozen terminal symbolic goal has a corresponding measured proxy predicate.
rollout_success.required_action_deletion: Execute every listed action, then evaluate the unchanged full terminal goal; success is expected to be false.
rollout_success.asset_or_layout_failure: Count as a failed rollout and preserve the failure; never replace the task.

evidence.screenshot_selection: Use the frozen pilot anchors in stratum order; never replace a failed row with a successful task.

claim_boundary: This is a procedural proxy-scene manipulation audit of plan order and goal binding under one robot and controller. It is not BEHAVIOR-native asset execution, category-faithful manipulation, navigation, perception, sim-to-real evidence, or a population success estimate.
